title: Fix botmux route bug
summary: Use project-scoped source references when diagnosing synthetic route drift in a bot bridge.

body_sections.context: A synthetic bot bridge route drift happened while parallel tasks were active.
body_sections.decision: Keep the draft local-only and require review before any broader visibility.
procedure: Compare the source window id against the intended recipient.
Check whether stale recipient context was reused across parallel messages.
Record the result as a project-scoped draft with source references.
